title: API Activity event (cloud control-plane and SaaS API telemetry for identity_compromise lateral hunt)
summary: OCSF API Activity events on two surfaces. Ingest: the identity_compromise playbook reads cloud control-plane calls (STS / AssumeRole chains, cross-tenant access), SaaS API token reuse, and OAuth-grant escalation attributable to the compromised principal within the configured lookback window. Emit: the business_continuity playbook emits one API Activity record per BCM lifecycle milestone (detect-and-declare, activate-plan, isolate, switch-to-backup, restore-and-verify) keyed to its event id — the house binding for workflow-emitted milestone records, which that playbook originally asserted under an invented `availability_activity` class (no availability class exists in OCSF through 1.4.0; provenance on issue #875).
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Application Activity category — API Activity class (uid 6003)
